mapper.sql: select id, meta_model_id, db_id, table_id, column_id, column_name, column_name_cn, column_order, create_date, update_date, remark from t_meta_source_uid
mapper.insert:
insert into t_meta_source_uid
id, meta_model_id, db_id, table_id, column_id, column_name, column_name_cn, column_order, remark, create_date
#{id}, #{metaModelId}, #{dbId}, #{tableId}, #{columnId}, #{columnName}, #{columnNameCn}, #{columnOrder}, #{remark}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
mapper.delete:
delete from t_meta_source_uid where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: where meta_model_id = #{metaModelId} order by db_id, table_id, column_order
select t.table_name as tableName, t.table_name_cn as tableNameCn, c.db_name as dbName, c.db_name_cn as dbNameCn from t_db_table t join t_db_config c on c.id = t.db_id where t.id = #{tableId}

select distinct r.relation_db_id as dbId, c.db_name_cn as dbName, r.relation_table_id as tableId, t.table_name as tableName, t.table_name_cn as tableNameCn from t_meta_model_relation r join t_db_config c ON r.relation_db_id = c.id join t_db_table t ON r.relation_table_id = t.id where r.model_id = #{modelId}

select u.id as id, u.meta_model_id as metaModelId, u.db_id as dbId, c.db_name_cn as dbName, u.table_id as tableId, u.column_id as columnId, u.column_name as columnName, u.column_name_cn as columnNameCn, u.column_order as columnOrder, t.table_name as tableName, t.table_name_cn as tableNameCn, case c.db_type when 'ORACLE' then c.db_username else c.db_name end as sourceDbName from t_meta_source_uid u join t_db_config c on u.db_id = c.id join t_db_table t on u.table_id = t.id where u.meta_model_id = #{metaModelId} order by u.db_id, u.table_id, u.column_order

select t.id as id, t.column_name as columnName, t.column_name_cn as columnNameCn, t.column_type as columnType, t.column_length as columnLength, IFNULL(u.column_order, 'not_uid') as columnOrder from t_db_table_column t left join t_meta_source_uid u on t.id = u.column_id where t.table_id = #{tableId} order by t.id
